posts.title: Master Your To-Do List with These 7 Rules
posts.description: Effective task management can enhance productivity and well-being. This article presents a 7-step plan including immediate task recording, the two-minute rule, specific action-oriented phrasing, including relevant details, prioritizing three essential tasks daily, aligning tasks with energy levels, and scheduling focus time. A key mindset tip emphasizes letting go of guilt over unfinished tasks.

posts.title: How to hack your circadian rhythm for better health and productivity
